# Rizky Irswanda

> Software and Internet of Things Engineer

## Summary
Rizky Irswanda is a Computer Science student and software engineer experienced in full-stack web development, desktop applications, backend systems, database engineering, and AIoT.

## Core Specializations
- Full-Stack Web Development: Next.js, React, TypeScript, PHP, Laravel, Tailwind CSS
- IoT and Embedded Systems: ESP32, ESP8266, Arduino, MQTT, Sensor Integration
- Backend and APIs: Node.js, Express, FastAPI, Python, REST APIs, Microservices
- Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis

## Key Projects
- Employee Information System (EIS): Enterprise HR platform for PT Komatsu Remanufacturing Asia
- PrimaCare ERP: Enterprise web platform built with Domain-Driven Design and distributed microservices
- SmartMedGuard: IoT hospital ward environmental monitoring system with multi-sensor telemetry over MQTT
- Web Penjaminan Mutu FSTI: Quality assurance platform for Kalimantan's Institute of Technology
